output_payload.regulatory_basis: SSA / IRS 2026 OASDI contribution and benefit base $184,500 (https://www.irs.gov/taxtopics/tc751, https://www.ssa.gov/oact/cola/cbb.html); IRC 3111(a) employer Social Security rate 6.2% (https://www.law.cornell.edu/uscode/text/26/3111); IRC 3111(b) employer Medicare rate 1.45% (https://www.law.cornell.edu/uscode/text/26/3111). output_payload.scope_note: This is an illustrative estimate, not tax advice. Reasonable compensation for an S corporation owner depends on the full facts and on current IRS guidance, which can change; consult a CPA or tax attorney. Employer payroll taxes are the employer share only (IRC 3111); the section 3101(b)(2) Additional Medicare Tax is an employee withholding with no employer match and is out of scope. Federal only: no state wage-base, unemployment-insurance, workers-comp or payroll-tax caps are modelled. One year only: the OASDI wage-base cap is applied as min(annual owner W-2, base), which assumes the whole year is already earned. A "replacement manager" is a single full-time manager; no partial, interim, or shared-role cost is modelled. The reasonable-compensation output is a neutral pattern observation, not a finding of unreasonable compensation, and not an accusation.
